description: This file contains the definition of the 'LibraryTypes' class within the Orleans.CodeGenerator namespace. It initializes and provides access to various type symbols and codec configurations used for code generation in Orleans serialization. It includes methods for determining if a type is shallow copyable, and holds references to external types, attributes, and codec descriptions.

classes.name: LibraryTypes
classes.description: A class that encapsulates information about types used in Orleans code generation, including type symbols for various Orleans and .NET types, and methods to determine type characteristics such as shallow copyability.

methods.name: FromCompilation
methods.description: Static method to create an instance of LibraryTypes from a Compilation object and options.

methods.name: IsShallowCopyable
methods.description: Determines if a given type symbol is shallow copyable based on predefined rules and attributes.

methods.name: IsValueTypeFieldsShallowCopyable
methods.description: Checks if all fields of a value type are shallow copyable.

methods.name: AreShallowCopyable
methods.description: Overloaded methods to check if a collection of types or fields are shallow copyable.
